pending.B3W-K0: B3 window class, K0. §3 asks for exact max over (window, test) of min_phi over all tests on windows of w <= 16; a window carries 2^(2^w) tests. Computed: the average case exactly by stationarity (mu is phi-invariant, so windows of equal length have equal marginals, checked) and sign-pattern decomposition over the union of supports; the deterministic worst case exactly for w <= 4 and as the U-form interval for 5 <= w <= 16.
pending.D-SIGN: Condition (d): |adv| (the literal §2 definition) lets a fixed chi alternate orientation across the window. Both readings are computed: 'signed' (Pr[chi = X_K'] - 1/2 >= 1/8 at every K') and 'abs' (|.| >= 1/8). A2 selects which is the COUNTEREXAMPLE rule; the other is a measurement.
pending.LF-A: Linear-filter observers: §3 defines them by rho_x(v) = A v XOR x b and does not state a. Computed for passive linear filters (a = 0), named so in every output.
pending.TAG-L: §6 item 5, COVERED-literature: the mechanical form of the four closed forms. Computed as L1-L4 (B1 fires on G_lin at n+1; B2 at lambda = n+1 equals 1 - Pr_Q[LC <= n+1] with its K_delta; the B4 counting horizon, subsumed by COVERED-corpus; a curve equal to max(0, 1 - 2^(n-K))), COVERED-corpus first. L2 as computed compares the B2 K1 horizons (maximum over lambda) with the closed form at lambda = n+1; that is conservative (it never gives a false COVERED tag) and tags only where lambda = n+1 is the earliest to fire. The exact comparison would use the closed-form K1 maximum over lambda; reading 'L1-L4' is the conservative form.
pending.WIT-A: Condition (a): which generators. Computed for the fixed G_lin(p_n), G_filt(p_n), G_clk(p_n); other family members enter through the K0 status only (conservative toward the claim under audit).
